description_en: Deletes a file or folder from a cloud drive
description_zh: 删除网盘中的文件或文件夹
kebab_example: aliyun ecd delete-cds-file --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cds-id cn-hangzhou+cds-0662240000 --file-id 6333e553a133ce21e6f747cf948bb9ef95d70000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteCdsFile

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who uses the cloud drive
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The file ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2247622.html to query the ID of the file
parameters.help_zh: 文件的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2247622.html接口查询对应文件的ID
parameters.name: file_id

Code.description_en: The execution result. The value `success` indicates success. Otherwise, an error message is returned
Code.description_zh: 执行结果。返回`success`表示成功，否则将返回错误信息

Data.description_en: Indicates whether data was returned successfully

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is not returned if Code is `success`
Message.description_zh: 错误信息。当Code为`success`时，不返回该参数

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation was successful
